turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is Naveen from the logistics hub in Bengaluru. I have a large shipment here for you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Shipment? I am not expecting anything right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is the industrial equipment order, the one valued at eighty thousand rupees. Did you not order this?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the machinery for the workshop! Yes, yes, I forgot about that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, sir. I just want to confirm if the address in Indiranagar is still correct?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, it is correct, but the main gate is currently closed for repairs.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem, sir. Should I ask the driver to wait at the side entrance instead?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, please do that. Will he be here today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he is about twenty minutes away. Please keep someone ready to receive the goods.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, Naveen. I will tell my son to go to the gate.
